## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation (8/11) but narrow top-stock leadership and multiple mega-cap divergences (NVDA, MSFT, META) produce mixed signals. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology lead: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy strong: MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.99%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Healthcare weak: ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND.  
Materials lagging: FCX (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) TREND EXHAUSTION, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) TREND EXHAUSTION, NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +20.69%), QCOM (1W: +18.92%), GOOGL (1W: +11.99%), MO (1W: +11.47%), GD (1W: +10.42%) — note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap techs showing 1W vs 1M disagreement (NVDA, MSFT, META) so treat momentum as tactical not fully structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with rotation within Tech: GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MSFT (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +12.20%) TREND EXHAUSTION — Tech 1W +1.83% overall; watch for consolidation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials constructive: V (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +0.95%) TREND EXHAUSTION — Financials 1W +1.48% and showing relative resilience.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare soft: UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND are bright spots while ISRG, SYK and JNJ are BELOW TREND; sector 1W -0.34% signals internal dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to pockets of strength in Technology winners (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL) and selective Energy/Financial cyclicals (MPC, PSX, JPM, V); reduce exposure to trend-exhausted mega-cap tech where 1W weakness contrasts with 1M gains (NVDA, MSFT, META). Monitor healthcare names with negative sentiment (SYK, ISRG) for risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) TREND EXHAUSTION, META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) TREND EXHAUSTION, SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W +4.25%) and Industrials (1W +1.00%) on earnings/upgrades.  
BEARISH: Materials (1W -2.03%) and Healthcare (1W -0.34%) for continued dispersion and negative headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA: reclaim short-term 1W gap and stabilize to negate trend exhaustion; watch for follow-through.  
GOOGL: sustained moves above this week’s breakout validate ABOVE TREND extension.  
JPM/V: continued 1W strength holding confirms Financials bid; failure to hold would signal rotation.  
MPC/PSX: consolidation above this week’s gains would confirm Energy strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GD (+80): Headline on raised 2026 EPS guidance; GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — 1W price reaction confirms the news but 1M still mixed.  
MPC (+60): Analyst upgrades/dividend; MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
UNH (+60): Q1 beat; UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed and accumulation evident.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
SHW (-50): negative outlook piece; SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
SYK (-50): PT cuts; SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed, downside pressure.  
MA (-45): guidance concerns flagged; MA (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +0.95%) TREND EXHAUSTION — news aligns with near-term weakness and divergence vs 1M.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech top performers.  
INTC, QCOM, GOOGL showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while NVDA, MSFT, META exhibit TREND EXHAUSTION.  
Key risk: major-cap divergences and negative healthcare/materials headlines could force rotation—monitor sentiment-confirmation for entries.
